description: User-authorized temporary IEx-visible diagnostic logs for live Mattermost investigation. Extend shared DeliveryExecutor boundary before bridge callbacks: explicit outgoing text plus safe structural plan; correlated start/end events for upload/send/edit, elapsed time, execution order and parallel worker activity, root/thread targets, safe results/IDs, failures/timeouts/skips. Keep bytes, credentials, source handles and private prepared requests out of logs. Preserve all current changes and immutable dependency pins; no commit/push. Validate focused existing executor/provider suites and mix q, record results. Remove temporary trace instrumentation after investigation.
